item.title: author post
item.content:encoded:
The first version of this that I can find is from December, 2018. It is older than that, but I don't know how much older.

This was originally meant to be used for a revival of the War on All Fronts canon, but I took a long time to actually get around to producing any articles for it and was dissatisfied with what I had. I decided to scrap the entire plotline, but didn't give up on a revival. This piece was the only I had finished for the revival at the time, and was always the first.

Then the Canon Renaissance Contest rolled around and one of the possible canons was War on All Fronts. I immediately knew I had to sign up for that, and did so immediately. My team set to using the vaguest of the same plot outlines, although changing almost everything about it. However, the start point — this article — didn't change. A few modifications to bring it inline with the rest of our entries and it was ready to go.

This is not an entry into the Canon Renaissance Contest, as it was written prior to the contest. It is the only article of my team that was written before the contest was announced.

Thanks to my critters: PopcornK, Elogee FishTruck and Team Mikasa Junior (J Dune, Ellie3 and chiifu).
